title: A Deadly Curse
summary: A group of people are searching for long-lost treasure in Saint Marie. One of them is found shot dead and the other one bit by a kissing bug.
method: The first victim was killed with the gun he was about to clean. The second victim was killed when a kissing bug was released from a box of matches he had.
motive: The two victims hadn't found the treasure but stumbled on palladium in the rainforest. They would've bought the land and demolished the rainforest to harvest the palladium.
killer: Benjamin, who did odd jobs in the area
notes: The team hid the motive on condition that Benjamin confessed to the murders. This hid the discovery from the rest of the group and saved the rainforest.
